optimization: Bulk scan ledger once with session/turn index, group boundaries and open calls; preserve late messages, delivery state, all groups and exact fingerprint bytes.
Reuse one frozen read within synchronous preflight; remeasure actual schemas, reread after I/O; retain all transactional provenance/version/epoch/deadline checks.
Pool only HTTP transport per profile; new model/usage state per lease, independent credentials/endpoints, cancellation closes its own response stream.
Include planning in background deadline; reject late stream first text and late transactional writes even if a provider suppresses cancellation.
Predict next-input room from latest input bytes + 512; tighter summary size target; hard checks continue on every real request.
Only advertise compact with a valid closed prefix and enough schema space; protected-only windows no longer invite futile compact calls.
